mentions.name: Moony Finance
mentions.description: An open source, local app for tracking personal wealth. It stores and tracks accounts, stock and crypto positions, loans, funds, and estates in one place without ads, subscriptions, or cloud, and exposes the data via MCP to Claude as a financial advisor.
mentions.problem: The author wanted something without ads, subscriptions, and cloud where all accounts, positions, loans, and funds could be stored and tracked in one place.
mentions.audience: Wanted an ad-free, subscription-free, cloud-free tool to store and track all personal financial accounts and positions in one place.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on an open source and local app for tracking one’s wealth.

I wanted something without ads, subscriptions and cloud, where I could throw in all my accounts, stock and crypto positions, loans, funds, estates etc to have it stored and tracked on one place and via MCP exposed to my Claude financial advisor.

https://moonyfinance.com/
